# BigQuery rejects type parameters in CAST and SAFE_CAST, which GoogleSQL accepts; they are for
# columns and script variables.

SELECT CAST('abcd' AS STRING(3))
=> error contains: Parameterized types are not allowed in CAST expressions.

SELECT CAST(x AS NUMERIC(3, 2)) FROM UNNEST([1.555]) x
=> error contains: Parameterized types are not allowed in CAST expressions.

SELECT SAFE_CAST(x AS NUMERIC(3, 2)) FROM UNNEST([123.4]) x
=> error contains: Parameterized types are not allowed in CAST expressions.
